notes.title: 2025.04.28 update
notes.notes:
Fix some bugs :)
Spirit Boost adjustment: During the first two minutes of the match, clearing 2 or more rows of blocks at once will grant double the score.

notes.title: 0.4.8 "Enchanted Invasion" Patch note
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added two new boards: Vixen & Slime Engine.
[*] Added configuration settings for two-player mode.
[*] Introduced a final boost mechanism, granting players corresponding buffs after a certain period.
[*] Redesigned multiple buffs.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.3.8: Sinful Tides Release Patch Note
notes.notes:
Added Paint tools: Leviathan & Alien Dolphin

[h1]Paint tool adjustments[/h1]

Primal: Brush size reduced from 0.5 to 0.38.
Scopia: Changed canvas shape & energy accumulation speed increased.
Mystical Creations: Changed canvas shape & added following description: "Each time when lines are cleared due to a Radiant, gain an additional Radiant."
Dice Deformer: Added following description: "Obtain 6 dices (up to 12) when start the game."
Spirit Boost: Brush size reduced from 0.44 to 0.38 & changed effect: "You will get double scores in the first 2 minutes."
